title: CSE Assignment Builder
description: A browser-based tool to build and export CSE assignment PDFs — cover page, pseudo code, algorithm, flow chart, source code & output — all in one click.

title: Anonymous Citizen Problem Portal
description: A platform where citizens can anonymously report local problems, concerns, and demands for review and public awareness.

title: Bangladesh Travel Map
description: An interactive tool where users select the districts of Bangladesh they've visited from all 64, choose their own colors, and download a personalized travel map. Includes district search, division-wise grouping, and a live visited counter.
